description.value: Emma Lea Farms is a family-run farm market and U-pick operation on Westham Island, accessed via a century-old wooden bridge, with roots going back to 1885. The farm market carries BC-grown fruit, local vegetables, spot prawns, honey, jams, SPCA Certified beef, and frozen goods — all sourced from the farm or elsewhere in British Columbia. An on-site Ice Cream Shoppe serving cones, milkshakes, smoothies, coffee, tea, and fresh baked goods makes it a memorable rest stop for cyclists riding the Westham Island loop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms address (2727 Westham Island Road, Ladner BC), phone (604-946-8216), and the farm market's product range (fresh produce, berries, SPCA beef, ice cream, baked goods, coffee/tea). No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or cycling-specific infrastructure anywhere on the site. OSM lists the community as Richmond but the website consistently identifies the location as Ladner, BC (Delta municipality), which is a geographic discrepancy worth flagging. OSM opening_hours tag shows Saturday only, but the website states Saturdays and Sundays.
concerns: OSM lists community as 'Richmond' but the website and address consistently identify the location as Ladner, BC (Delta municipality) — the community tag appears to be incorrect.
OSM opening_hours tag shows Saturday only ('Sa 10:00-15:00'), but the website states the Farm Market is open Saturdays and Sundays — OSM hours are incomplete.
Website states 'CASH/DEBIT ONLY' — no credit cards accepted; relevant context for touring cyclists.
Farm has a strict No Pets Policy, which may affect cyclists travelling with dogs.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established BC farm market on a popular cycling destination (Westham Island) offering fresh local produce, ice cream, and hot beverages — a clear benefit to touring cyclists passing through the area.
enrichment_extras.notes: U-pick berries (strawberries, raspberries, blueberries, and specialty varieties) available seasonally. Fresh pressed juices also sold at the stand.

Hot food.detail: Ice Cream Shoppe offers tea, coffee, and fresh baked goods
